# The bowl I stopped sanding

The unglazed base still catches a little on the table. I can improve it indefinitely by imagining a fussier owner. Put felt under this one and change the trimming on the next batch. [[Pottery]] needs a distinction between making an object safe and making it impossible to criticize. Tonight I would rather have dinner than a perfect foot ring.
